newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico chemical unit sees record '96 output.
newsitem.headline: Mexico chemical unit sees record '96 output.

text.p: The chemical division of Mexico's Grupo Acerero del Norte (GAN), Agro Nitrogenados, saw record fertilizer production in 1996, GAN said in a bimonthly report.
The unit's urea production was 1.08 million tonnes, up from 967,626 tonnes in 1995, the company said. GAN's urea production in 1995 accounted for 64 percent of the nation's total output.
In pelletized urea, output was 974,200 tonnes, compared with 798,982 tonnes in 1995. Production fell in UAN-32 to 299,187 tonnes in 1996 from 462,824 tonnes the year before.

Ammonium nitrate solution production rose to 258,186 tonnes from 236,057 tonnes in 1995, while ammonium nitrate-industrial grade output was 6,735 tonnes from 6,084 tonnes. Ammonium nitrate-agricultural grade output shot up to 121,463 tonnes from 29,704 tonnes produced in 1995.
